Chapter 374: Chapter 2 Chikun Star Lord: Disciple, why is your Inner World so large? (Please Subscribe)_2

Soon enough,

evolvers were unable to find the Martial Path Evolutionary Path in the fourth or fifth spots and subconsciously looked up, only to see it ranked second.

In the blink of an eye,

the Central Plaza Area exploded into an uproar.

“Are you kidding me?”

“Ranked second?”

...

“I remember the second and third evolutionary paths were both Eighth Layer Paths, weren’t they?”

“Did the Martial Path Evolutionary Path surpass two Eighth Layer Paths?”

“Could it be that the founder scholar has uploaded both the Seventh Rank Chapter and Eighth Layer Part? Otherwise, how could it possibly surpass the Eighth Layer Evolution Paths?”

“No, I glanced at it just now, and at present, the highest rank for the Martial Path Evolutionary Path is only Seventh Rank.”

“My God, a Seventh Rank Evolution Path ranking actually surpassed an Eighth Layer Evolution Path?”

…

Countless evolvers were full of disbelief, feeling as if their understanding of the world was beginning to shatter.

How could a Seventh Rank Evolution Path, even if it were exceptional, possibly surpass the lofty Eighth Layer Evolution Paths that gave rise to Eighth Layer Evolvers?

“I have purchased the Martial Path Evolutionary Path Seventh Rank Chapter, and I really want to see what’s in it that made the three goddesses rate it so highly.”

“Me too, the three goddesses are absolutely impartial; they wouldn’t act out of favoritism. If the Martial Path Evolutionary Path can surpass the Eighth Layer Evolution Paths, it definitely must have something outstandingly remarkable…”

One after another, evolvers began to purchase the Seventh Rank Chapter to find out more.

…

On Chikun Main Star,

Lin Yuan stepped out of the grand hall amidst the Thirteen Peaks and strolled around leisurely.

Before the Red Spirit Fluid arrived, he had nothing to attend to. As for further contemplating the space models? Continuing that would soon push Lin Yuan’s ability to suppress the natural expansion of his Inner World to its limits.

“Hm?”

“Why is everyone discussing the Martial Path Evolutionary Path?”

Lin Yuan raised an eyebrow as he noticed many members of the Red Kun Lineage were talking about the Martial Path Evolutionary Path.

The Red Kun Lineage was the absolute ruler of the Chikun Star Domain; ordinary matters hardly affected its many members.

Thus, even when the Martial Path Evolutionary Path broke into the Chikun Evolution Rankings at sixth place with its Sixth Rank Chapter, it only sparked a limited discussion within the Red Kun Lineage.

But now?

The discussions had escalated to a broad scale, and it was not just widespread debate but involved everyone.

The Red Kun Lineage typically paid little attention to Seventh Rank Evolution Paths, even the strongest one.

But the Eighth Layer Paths… each new Eighth Layer Path indicated the emergence of a great Evolver scholar.

What’s more, this time the Martial Path Evolutionary Path, with its Seventh Rank level basis, forcibly inserted itself into the realm of the Eighth Layer Paths.

It was utterly inconceivable.

In fact, it wasn’t just the Chikun Star Domain discussing this; nearby star domains, and even the vast ‘Annan’ Star Alliance, were abuzz with evolvers talking about it.

…

In the crimson palace,

the Chikun Star Lord purchased the Martial Path Evolutionary Path Seventh Rank Chapter.

Then, he began reading it meticulously.

“Hmm… this evolutionary path does not constrain a specific direction but is based on the strengths of the evolver; it is indeed remarkable…”

The Chikun Star Lord nodded slightly.

“Still, just on this merit alone, it wants to surpass the Eighth Layer Evolution Paths?”

The Chikun Star Lord looked puzzled.

If it relied only on popularity, it was virtually impossible to shake the status of the Eighth Layer Evolution Paths.

No matter how many Seventh Rank Evolvers there were, they couldn’t compare to a single Eighth Layer Evolver.

“Perhaps, there’s something I’m not yet aware of?”

The Chikun Star Lord mused to himself.

The Seventh Rank Chapter of the Martial Path Evolutionary Path offered evolvers an enormous range of path directions to choose from, touching not only on the basic rules but also on fundamental pillars.

Unless the Chikun Star Lord decided to walk the Martial Path Evolutionary Path from scratch, it would be hard for him to notice the subtleties within.

“Forget it, it’s probably the masterpiece of some old geezer from the Central Star Domain; if I can’t understand it, there’s no use in looking any further.”

With a slight shake of his head, the Chikun Star Lord also thought the Martial Path Evolutionary Path originated from one of the great Evolver scholars, perhaps even a high-ranking scholar from the Central Star Domain.

The thoughts of such lofty scholars were beyond even the Chikun Star Lord’s comprehension.

“However, why did my clever disciple request so much Red Spirit Fluid?”

The Chikun Star Lord’s thoughts shifted as he pondered.

The amount of Red Spirit Fluid that Lin Yuan had requested surprised even the Chikun Star Lord—it was enough for an ordinary Eighth Layer Peak Evolver to practice for hundreds of years.

For Lin Yuan, a Seventh Rank Evolver, to request so much Red Spirit Fluid seemed pointless.

Nevertheless, although the Chikun Star Lord found Lin Yuan’s request strange,

he approved it immediately.

The Chikun Star Lord admitted to himself that it was difficult to guide the cultivation of a prodigy like Lin Yuan.

If he couldn’t give guidance, then he wouldn’t try; he would simply agree to Lin Yuan’s various requests.

“Where on earth would one need so much Red Spirit Fluid?” the Chikun Star Lord wondered, mulling over the possibilities. “Could it be for cultivating an Inner World?”

The Chikun Star Lord’s eyes lit up.

In the past, when Lin Yuan had broken through to the Seventh Rank, the Chikun Star Lord faintly sensed spatial fluctuations coming from the depths of the Thirteen Peaks where Lin Yuan was.

At the time, the Chikun Star Lord assumed Lin Yuan simply possessed some kind of spatial treasure.

Indeed, if one had a rare spatial treasure, it was possible to attempt cultivating an Inner World even before reaching the Seventh Rank Peak.

“But even for cultivating an Inner World, he wouldn’t need this much Red Spirit Fluid…”

The Chikun Star Lord fell back into doubt.

“Whatever the case may be,

I’ll just pay closer attention for a while.”

After thinking for a moment, the Chikun Star Lord resumed his practice.

…

A few days later,

Lin Yuan looked at the water jugs laid out before him.
